description: Sets the order of a projects showcase's projects on the website. Use it when the user wants projects in a specific order, e.g. newest or featured first. Pass projects in the new order; ones you leave out keep their current order after them.

projects.description: Projects (slugs, titles, or ids) in their new order, e.g. ["arched-entry-two-story", "lakeside-remodel"].

showcaseId.description: Projects showcase id from list_showcases, e.g. "0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f".

name: reorder_projects
title: Reorder projects
